steps.eval: (()=>{const map=window.AtlasOpenBasemap&&window.AtlasOpenBasemap.map;if(!map)return 'no basemap';const svg=document.querySelector('svg#atlas'),host=document.querySelector('#atlas-basemap');const ctm=svg.getScreenCTM(),hr=host.getBoundingClientRect();let m=[0,0];for(const ll of [[-99.1,19.4],[-74,40.7],[-70.6,-33.4],[-45,70]]){const p=window.Atlas.screenPoint(ll);const sp=svg.createSVGPoint();sp.x=p[0];sp.y=p[1];const c=sp.matrixTransform(ctm);const q=map.project(ll);const d=[Math.round(c.x-(hr.x+q.x)),Math.round(c.y-(hr.y+q.y))];if(Math.hypot(...d)>Math.hypot(...m))m=d}return 'layers are '+m[0]+','+m[1]+' px from the basemap; equator at y='+Math.round(window.Atlas.screenPoint([-90,0])[1])})()

(async()=>{const svg=document.querySelector('svg#atlas');const r=svg.getBoundingClientRect();const x=r.x+r.width*.6,y=r.y+r.height*(.3);const sleep=t=>new Promise(f=>setTimeout(f,t));for(let z=0;z<0;z++){document.querySelector('#zoom-out').click();await sleep(500)}const ev=(t,el,cy)=>el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent(t,{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,view:window,clientX:x,clientY:cy,button:0,buttons:t==='mouseup'?0:1}));for(let k=0;k<2;k++){ev('mousedown',svg,y);for(let i=1;i<=10;i++){ev('mousemove',window,y+(300)*i/10);await sleep(20)}ev('mouseup',window,y+(300));await sleep(500)}return 1})()
